settings.heading: How often should I use these?
settings.row_content: Use as directed on the package, typically a few times per week, for best results. Avoid overuse to prevent sensitivity.

settings.heading: Will this cause tooth sensitivity?
settings.row_content: It's formulated to be gentle, but some people may experience mild sensitivity. If this happens, reduce frequency or discontinue use and consult your dentist.

settings.heading: Do I need to wet the strips first?
settings.row_content: No, these are designed for dry application — just apply directly to clean, dry teeth.

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.row_content: The purple color-correction gives an instant visual effect, while whitening actives work gradually over 1-2 weeks of consistent use.

settings.heading: A Brighter Smile, On Your Schedule

settings.text: Apply the dry strip whenever you have a few minutes — no sink, no water, no mess. Peel it off and go about your day with a smile that looks instantly brighter.

settings.caption: 01 — Formula
settings.heading: Instant + Gradual Whitening
settings.text: Most whitening strips rely on time and peroxide alone. Ours pairs purple color-correction for an instant visual effect with gentle whitening actives that work gradually — so you see a difference right away and over time.

settings.text: No wetting, no rinsing, no mess. Just apply the dry strip whenever fits your day, and remove when you're done — a whitening routine that actually fits into a busy schedule.
